claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ketoprofen is a non-cytotoxic COX inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any weak antiproliferative effect would reflect non-specific NSAID/COX-independent activity rather than a targeted cytotoxic mechanism.
